set.body:
Implement the first reusable pure trace/event scene and standalone export example through the existing Intaglio/Studio viz boundaries, respecting that library modules cannot depend on Studio. Reuse or extract an appropriate lower-level scene seam after checking S4 ownership; do not fork a second graphics stack. Acceptance: real rendered specimen from pinned results, explicit axes/units/gaps/events, accessibility and overlap cases, public consumer export with provenance. Coordinate PM4.1 and S4/S9, and queue main-sequence, QC and reading-family gaps before any visual-completeness claim.

Keep each implementation review below roughly half a day; if the scope exceeds that, split before implementation and retain the parent acceptance. Follow repository law/mutation and landing gates. This is required gap work owned by the comparison epic; completion needs evidence, not title closure.
set.title: PM4.2 Expose one standalone trace-and-event figure from verified results
